title: C++ Comments
description: Line and block comments, how the compiler strips them, why block comments do not nest, and when a comment is actually worth writing.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: 行註釋與區塊註釋、編譯器如何移除它們、區塊註釋為何不能嵌套，以及甚麼時候才值得寫註釋。

questions.prompt: Given the comment `/* a /* b */ c */`, what does the compiler treat as the comment?

prompt.zh-Hant: 對於 `/* a /* b */ c */`，編譯器會把哪一段視為註釋？

a.zh-Hant: 只有 `/* a /* b */` 是註釋，後面的 `c */` 會被當成程式碼。

b.zh-Hant: 整行都是註釋，因為區塊註釋可以嵌套。

c.zh-Hant: 整段 `/* a /* b */ c */` 都是註釋，因為編譯器會配對兩個結束標記。

d.zh-Hant: 甚麼都不是，嵌套區塊註釋在 C++ 是非法語法。

explanation.zh-Hant: 區塊註釋不會嵌套：遇到第一個 */ 就結束，因此後面的 c */ 會變成程式碼，通常造成編譯錯誤。

options.text: Only `/* a /* b */` is the comment; `c */` is code.
The whole line, because block comments nest.
All of `/* a /* b */ c */`, because the compiler pairs both closing markers.
Nothing, because nested block comments are illegal C++.

questions.explanation: Block comments do not nest: the first */ ends the comment, so the trailing c */ becomes code and usually triggers a compile error.

questions.prompt: What happens to a comment during translation?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在翻譯過程中，註釋會變成甚麼？

a.zh-Hant: 在程式被解析之前就被替換成一個空白，因此不會進入程式碼產生階段。

b.zh-Hant: 被寫進目的檔，讓除錯器可以顯示註釋。

c.zh-Hant: 當作中介資料傳給連結器。

d.zh-Hant: 保留在執行檔中，並在啟用斷言時執行。

explanation.zh-Hant: 註釋在翻譯階段 3 就被換成一個空白，只留下分隔記號的作用；它們不會產生指令，也不會傳給連結器。

options.text: It is replaced by a single space before the program is parsed, so it never reaches code generation.
It is stored in the object file so debuggers can show it.
It is passed to the linker as metadata.
It is kept in the executable and executed when assertions are enabled.

questions.explanation: Comments are replaced by a single space in translation phase 3, before parsing, so they produce no instructions and are never sent to the linker.

questions.prompt: Comments are removed before code generation, so they add no instructions to the compiled program.

prompt.zh-Hant: 註釋會在程式碼產生之前被移除，因此不會為編譯後的程式增加任何指令。

explanation.zh-Hant: 註釋在翻譯階段 3 就處理完畢，遠早於最佳化與程式碼產生，所以不可能增加執行期的負擔。

questions.explanation: Comments are handled in translation phase 3, long before the optimiser and code generator run, so they cannot add run-time work.

questions.prompt: `#if 0 ... #endif` is handled by the comment rules of the compiler.

prompt.zh-Hant: `#if 0 ... #endif` 是由編譯器的註釋規則處理的。

explanation.zh-Hant: #if 0 是前置處理器的條件編譯：由前置處理器跳過其中的記號，不是註釋掃描器，因此可以嵌套。

questions.explanation: It is a preprocessor conditional: the enclosed tokens are skipped by the preprocessor rather than by the comment scanner, so the block can be nested.

questions.prompt: Which statements about comments are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列關於註釋的敘述，哪些正確？可多選。

c.zh-Hant: `/* ... */` 可以嵌套，所以 `/* /* */ */` 是一個完整的註釋。

d.zh-Hant: `//` 註釋中可以出現 `/*` 字元，而不會開始區塊註釋。

explanation.zh-Hant: 區塊註釋可跨行但不能嵌套；行註釋到換行就結束，所以其中的 /* 只是普通文字。

options.text: A `/* ... */` comment may span several lines.
A `//` comment runs to the end of the line.
`/* ... */` comments nest, so `/* /* */ */` is a complete comment.
A `//` comment may contain the characters `/*` without starting a block comment.

questions.explanation: Block comments may span lines but do not nest. A line comment ends at the newline, so a /* inside it is just text.

questions.prompt: Which of these are good reasons to write a comment? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是寫註釋的好理由？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 說明某個不明顯的權宜做法為何必要。

b.zh-Hant: 記錄公開函式的契約：前置條件、資源擁有權與單位。

c.zh-Hant: 逐行重述程式碼，例如在 i++; 後面寫 // 把 i 加一。

d.zh-Hant: 留下標明後續追蹤議題的 TODO。

explanation.zh-Hant: 好的註釋補充程式碼說不出口的資訊：意圖、契約、限制與待辦事項。逐行重述只會增加維護負擔，程式一改就過時。

options.text: Explaining why a non-obvious workaround is needed.
Documenting the contract of a public function: preconditions, ownership and units.
Restating each line, such as `i++; // increment i`.
Leaving a TODO that names the issue to follow up.

questions.explanation: Good comments add what the code cannot say: intent, contracts, constraints and follow-up work. Restating each line only adds maintenance cost and goes stale.

questions.prompt: What is the effect of the comment in `int/**/x = 1;`?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在 `int/**/x = 1;` 中，該註釋有甚麼作用？

a.zh-Hant: 它扮演記號分隔符，因此這個宣告是合法的。

b.zh-Hant: 它把前後記號黏在一起，產生識別字 intx。

c.zh-Hant: 這是語法錯誤，宣告中間不可以有註釋。

d.zh-Hant: 它把宣告的其餘部分註釋掉，因此 x 沒有被定義。

explanation.zh-Hant: 註釋被替換成一個空白，剛好把 int 與 x 分開，所以 `int x = 1;` 合法；若沒有這個空白，intx 會是另一個識別字。

options.text: It acts as a token separator, so the declaration is valid.
It glues the tokens together, producing the identifier intx.
It is a syntax error, because a comment may not appear inside a declaration.
It comments out the rest of the declaration, so x is never defined.

questions.explanation: The comment becomes one space, which conveniently separates int from x, so the declaration is valid. Without that separation intx would be a single identifier.

b.zh-Hant: 甚麼都不輸出，因為字串裡的 // 會開始註釋。

d.zh-Hant: 無法編譯，因為字串中不可以有 //。

explanation.zh-Hant: 這些字元位於字串常值之內，其中的 // 只是一般文字，不會開始註釋。

options.text: // done
Nothing, because the // inside the string starts a comment.
done
It does not compile, because a string may not contain //.

questions.explanation: The characters are inside a string literal, where a // sequence is ordinary text rather than the start of a comment.

questions.prompt: A block comment begins with `/*` and ends with ____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 區塊註釋以 `/*` 開始，並以 ____ 結束。

explanation.zh-Hant: 區塊註釋以 */ 結束，而且不會嵌套：第一個 */ 就會關閉它。

questions.explanation: A block comment is closed by */, and the first */ closes it because block comments do not nest.

questions.prompt: A colleague writes `i++; // add one to i`. In one or two sentences, explain why this comment is low value and what a better comment would say.

prompt.zh-Hant: 同事在 `i++;` 後面寫了 `// 把 i 加一`。用一至兩句說明這個註釋為何價值不高，以及比較好的註釋會寫甚麼。

model.zh-Hant: 它只是重述程式碼已經明講的事，沒有增加資訊，程式一改就容易過時。好的註釋會說明意圖或不易看出來的限制，例如這裡為何要加一（例如跳過表頭列）。

explanation.zh-Hant: 判斷標準是：刪掉這行註釋，讀者會少了甚麼？如果甚麼都沒少，它就只是噪音。

answer.model: It only repeats what the code already says, so it adds no information and goes stale when the code changes. A better comment explains intent or a non-obvious constraint, for example why one is added here, such as skipping a header row.

questions.explanation: The test is what a reader would lose if the comment were deleted. If the answer is nothing, the comment is noise.
